stories.title: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visits India (Jan 12–13)
stories.body: Ahmedabad and Bengaluru; 19 strategic agreements covering defence tech, critical minerals, supply chains and clean energy; India–UAE agreed to double bilateral trade to $200 billion by 2032 with a new Strategic Defence Partnership.

stories.title: ISRO's PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 mission faces third-stage anomaly on Jan 12
stories.body: 64th PSLV flight carrying DRDO's strategic surveillance satellite Anvesha plus 15 co-passenger satellites (7 from Dhruva Space); mission data under analysis; NSIL's 9th dedicated commercial launch.
